versions.localizedDescription:
Rebranded from Kodoku to Dokuha ("io.github.sfai05.Dokuha", default PocketBase collection "dokuha_sync_snapshots", keeping the existing app icon), plus new Library & Metadata features:

• Rename app branding, bundle ID, SideStore/AltStore source metadata, and PocketBase default schema to Dokuha (#28)
• Replace Library category dropdown with a one-tap horizontal capsule pill bar (#27)
• Add Library Filter & Sort bottom sheet with tri-state filters and removable active filter chips (#25)
• Allow editing per-manga Content Rating and mapping it from MangaBaka metadata pulls (#23)

Migration Note: Because the bundle identifier changed from "io.github.sfai05.Kodoku" to "io.github.sfai05.Dokuha", install Dokuha as a fresh app in SideStore/AltStore (if SideStore warns about the updated source identifier, remove and re-add the "apps.json" source URL). On existing PocketBase servers, rename "kodoku_sync_snapshots" to "dokuha_sync_snapshots" (or recreate via Setup Wizard / "docs/sync/pb_schema.json"), or set the legacy collection name in Sync Settings.
